title: Buttons | Apple Developer Documentation - [Role](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/buttons\#Role)
claim: Don’t assign the primary role to a button that performs a destructive action, even if that action is the most likely choice.** Because of its visual prominence, people sometimes choose a primary button without reading it first. Help people avoid losing content by assigning the primary role to nondestructive buttons.
